A '''microphone''' was a communications device<ref name="GG7" /> used to record sound for later playback. [[3D-4X administrative droid]]s were equipped with a microphone to enable them to carry out their [[Administrator/Legends|administrative]] duties.<ref name="ETGD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
